set.body: Build the recall-blind source identity graph for the Sherlock body scenes from video observations, ASR, captions and optional annotations, before and without any recall text. An LLM may propose links (proposal-only, rule 13); the S3a resolver accepts each by licence class; every accepted and refused proposal keeps a receipt. Captions from the same frames are not independent corroboration. Acceptance: reproducible graph with receipts; identity precision per basis class; the depicted/described link of the body case either licensed with a cited basis or Open with candidates. Paid model calls need owner authorization.
set.title: [evidence-binding S3c] Recall-blind source identity graph for the Sherlock body scenes
